recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat any future cleanup of redundant or stale example-index prose as a separate editorial issue, not as remaining FHIR-8070 work.

additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in the current build. The current examples List carries description extensions for all MedicationStatement examples, including later history that restored the MedicationStatement name and added a no-medications example with its own description. reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already conveys the requested example intent and detail; adding more narrative would be redundant rather than a semantic correction.
